summary: Tested all three Celesta Glow cart fixes — tiered delivery+tax, qty/badge sync with localStorage pruning, and cart-item link-to-PDP — plus regression on coupons/gift card/upsell/checkout. 13/13 backend pytest pass (all 6 tier bands verified at exact spec values, plus pruning, coupons APR26/WELCOME50/invalid, invalid gift card, free-ship nudge). Frontend Playwright: 14/14 assertions pass — localStorage correctly pruned of inactive 'nonexistent-product-slug' on /cart load, navbar badge stays in lockstep with cart qty value (2→1 after minus click within ~600ms incl. optimistic + validateCart roundtrip), cart-item-image-link-0 and cart-item-title-link-0 both navigate to /product/anti-aging-serum, qty +/- and trash buttons do NOT navigate, next-tier nudge visible below ₹1000 with 'Spend X more to unlock 30% OFF taxes' text, qualified-banner shown above ₹1000, coupons + gift-card flow + upsell similar products + Proceed to Checkout all working. Screenshot confirms tier (c): subtotal ₹1998 → Taxes ₹64 (with '35% OFF' pill, original ₹99 struck-through), Delivery ₹29 (₹49 struck-through), next-tier nudge 'Add ₹2 more to unlock 40% OFF taxes'.

issues: Some upsell card images still render as decorative SVG placeholders on initial paint (Vitamin C Glow, Pore Refiner Serum) — same as iter8 finding, not blocking. Real product photos appear for others (Rose Clay Mask, Under Eye Cream, etc.).

action_items: None blocking. (Optional) Investigate intermittent placeholder rendering for a couple of upsell cards on first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend tier rounding: tax_charges = round(99 * (1 - pct)). Python's banker's rounding produces 50 for ≥₹5000 tier (99*0.5=49.5→50) and 59 for ≥₹2000 (99*0.6=59.4→59) — matches spec exactly. No off-by-one risk.

next_tier short-circuit loop is correct: returns FIRST tier above pre_ship_total and None when ≥₹5000. Label dynamically omits delivery component when delivery is unchanged across tiers — nice UX touch.
CartPage.js prune logic compares pruned vs cart.items by length AND quantity, so saveCart is only called when a real change occurred — avoids needless localStorage writes & re-renders.

Link-vs-div conditional wrap (detailHref ? Link : 'div') correctly skips navigation for combo items that have no product slug. Qty +/- and remove buttons sit OUTSIDE the TitleWrap/ImageWrap so they don't trigger navigation — verified.

Optimistic update mutates cartData state locally before validateCart resolves; if the server response disagrees the state is reconciled on the next render. Tested with rapid minus click — no flicker, no lag with navbar badge.
test_credentials: Not required. Public coupons APR26/WELCOME50/APRGLOW/MAYEARLY auto-seeded.
seed_data_creation: Cart seeded in localStorage only (no DB writes). Slugs used: anti-aging-serum (₹999), under-eye-cream (₹549), sunscreen (₹499).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_cart_tiers_jan2026.py covers all 6 tier bands and regression. Re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_cart_tiers_jan2026.py -v`. Note: hitting tiers b (1000-1500) and d (2000-2500) requires MIXING slugs because anti-aging-serum sells at ₹999 (single-product qty jumps overshoot). Use under-eye-cream (₹549) + sunscreen (₹499) for tier b and add anti-aging-serum for tier d. Tier c, e, f are reachable with anti-aging-serum alone at qty 2/3/6.
rca of the issue: N/A — testing-only iteration. All three reported fixes verified working end-to-end.
